text_en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, To the saints who are in Ephesus and are faithful in Christ Jesus:
text_cn: 因天主的旨意，做耶稣基督宗徒的保禄，致书给那些【在厄弗所的】圣徒和信仰基督耶稣的人。

text_en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 愿恩宠与平安，由我们的父天主和主耶稣基督，赐与你们！

text_en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places,
text_cn: 愿我们的主耶稣基督的天主和父受赞美！他在天上，在基督内，以各种属神的祝福，祝福了我们，

text_en: just as he chose us in Christ before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless before him in love.
text_cn: 因为他于创世以前，在基督内已拣选了我们，为使我们在他面前，成为圣洁无瑕疵的；

text_en: He destined us for adoption as his children through Jesus Christ, according to the good pleasure of his will,
text_cn: 又由于爱，按照自己旨意的决定，预定了我们藉着耶稣基督获得义子的名分，而归于他，

text_en: to the praise of his glorious grace that he freely bestowed on us in the Beloved.
text_cn: 为颂扬他恩宠的光荣，这恩宠是他在自己的爱子内赐与我们的；

text_en: In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace
text_cn: 我们就是全凭天主丰厚的恩宠，在他的爱子内，藉他爱子的血，获得了救赎，罪过的赦免。

text_en: that he lavished on us. With all wisdom and insight
text_cn: 的确，天主丰厚地把这恩宠倾注在我们身上，赐与我们各种智慧和明达，

text_en: he has made known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure that he set forth in Christ,
text_cn: 为使我们知道，他旨意的奥秘，是全照他在爱子内所定的计划：

text_en: as a plan for the fullness of time, to gather up all things in him, things in heaven and things on earth.
text_cn: 就是依照他的措施，当时期一满，就使天上和地上的万有，总归于基督元首。

text_en: In Christ we have also obtained an inheritance, having been destined according to the purpose of him who accomplishes all things according to his counsel and will,
text_cn: 我们也是在基督内得作天主的产业，因为我们是由那位按照自己旨意的计划施行万事者，早预定了的，

text_en: so that we, who were the first to set our hope on Christ, might live for the praise of his glory.
text_cn: 为使我们这些首先在默西亚内怀着希望的人，颂扬他的光荣；

text_en: In him you also, when you had heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation, and had believed in him, were marked with the seal of the promised Holy Spirit;
text_cn: 在基督内你们一听到了真理的话，即你们得救的福音，便信从了，且在他内受了恩许圣神的印证；

text_en: this is the pledge of our inheritance toward redemption as God’s own people, to the praise of his glory.
text_cn: 这圣神就是我们得嗣业的保证，为使天主所置为嗣业的子民，蒙受完全的救赎，为颂扬他的光荣。

text_en: I have heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love toward all the saints, and for this reason
text_cn: 因此，我一听见你们对主耶稣的信德和对众圣徒的爱德，

text_en: I do not cease to give thanks for you as I remember you in my prayers.
text_cn: 便不断为你们感谢天主，在我的祈祷中记念你们，

text_en: I pray that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation as you come to know him,
text_cn: 为使我们的主耶稣基督的天主，即那光荣的父，把智慧和启示的神恩，赐与你们，好使你们认识他；

text_en: so that, with the eyes of your heart enlightened, you may know what is the hope to which he has called you, what are the riches of his glorious inheritance among the saints,
text_cn: 并光照你们心灵的眼目，为叫你们认清他的宠召有什么希望，在圣徒中他嗣业的光荣，是怎样丰厚；

text_en: and what is the immeasurable greatness of his power for us who believe, according to the working of his great power.
text_cn: 他对我们虔信的人，所施展的强有力而见效的德能是怎样的伟大。

text_en: God put this power to work in Christ when he raised him from the dead and seated him at his right hand in the heavenly places,
text_cn: 正如他已将这德能施展在基督身上，使他从死者中复活，叫他在天上坐在自己右边，

text_en: far above all rule and authority and power and dominion, and above every name that is named, not only in this age but also in the age to come.
text_cn: 超乎一切率领者、掌权者、异能者、宰制者，以及一切现世及来世可称呼的名号以上；

text_en: And he has put all things under his feet and has made him the head over all things for the church,
text_cn: 又将万有置于他的脚下，使他在教会内作至上的元首，

text_en: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
text_cn: 这教会就是基督的身体，就是在一切内充满一切者的圆满。
